name: White dunes
summary: Pale dunes at Bàu Trắng: be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00 for the sunrise before the heat. The field is in Hoa Thang, with steep 30-metre slopes and a lotus lake. The drive runs from a short hop off the beach strip out to 25 km. Set the alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan. Midday sand is scorching.
getThere: A short hop off the beach strip, out to 25 km.
heroCaption: Pale dune crests, with people small on the sand

notice.title: Be there at sunrise
notice.body: Set the alarm for 4:30 if an ATV at sunrise is the plan, and be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00. Midday sand is scorching.

body: Climb the pale slopes at sunrise, look over the lotus lake, and sandboard the 30-metre faces. An ATV or an open jeep is the other way across the field. Be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00. Set a 4:30 alarm when the plan is an ATV at sunrise.

Midday sand is scorching, so the early window is the visit. The drive runs from a short hop off the main beach strip out to 25 km. A motorbike covers the dunes. The red dunes are the sunset slope. Bàu Trắng is the symbol of the national tourism zone, and Bàu Sen is protected with it.

figures.caption: Pale ridges and tracks across Bàu Trắng
figures.alt: Pale white sand ridges at Bau Trang with footprints and vehicle tracks

gettingThere: Bàu Trắng is in Hoa Thang, Bac Binh, inside the national tourism zone, with steep 30-metre dunes and a lotus lake. From the main beach strip the drive runs from a short hop out to 25 km.

legs.heading: From the Ham Tien strip
legs.body: A motorbike from the beach strip, a short hop out to 25 km. Be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00.

admissionNote: Be on the sand from 5:00 to 7:00. An ATV or a jeep is extra. Set the alarm for 4:30 when the plan is an ATV at sunrise. Midday sand is scorching.
